title: Law of Independent Assortment
text: Mendel's Law of Independent Assortment states that alleles of different genes separate independently during gamete formation. Each gamete gets one allele from each gene.

title: FOIL Method for Gametes
text: For BbSs: First allele B can combine with S or s (giving BS, Bs). Second allele b can combine with S or s (giving bS, bs).
